user_reported_bug: Collect PRC button not working on dashboard — 'button dead — कोणतीच action hot नाही' (nothing happens on click). Reproduced on production https://www.parasreward.com / bugzappers.emergent.host with mobile 9970100782. Production is on v1.3.8 but user reports the button still does nothing.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused retest verified backend collect works, collect button renders, parent 25s safety timer fires after double-tap, and 36/36 requested pytests pass. However the normal user-visible forced-ad modal does not render at all after clicking Collect; the user sees no immediate action until the 25.86s fallback collects PRC, so the reported 'button dead/nothing happens' symptom is still partially reproducible.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking data-testid='collect-rewards-btn' did not render data-testid='forced-ad-overlay' or data-testid='forced-ad-modal' (overlay_count=0, modal_count=0). Code review shows ForcedAdInterstitial is only mounted in the idle-state return, while the Collect button is in the active-session return.

integration_issues.issue: The parent safety net eventually called /api/mining/collect after 25.86s and showed 'Collected 31.55 PRC', but there was no immediate visible click response/ad interstitial. This can still feel like a dead button to users.

action_items: Mount ForcedAdInterstitial outside the active/idle conditional returns (or include it in the active-session JSX) so Collect immediately shows the ad/fallback UI when forcedAdOpen=true.
Add immediate user feedback on Collect click (modal/loading state or toast) so the 25s safety fallback is not perceived as a dead button if the modal/ad SDK fails.
Keep the parent safety timer; it passed the stuck-modal/double-tap fallback test. Add a regression test that asserts forced-ad overlay appears from the active MiningWidget collect path.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/components/MiningWidget.js lines ~320-435 return the active-session UI containing the Collect button before the ForcedAdInterstitial JSX at lines ~513-526, so forcedAdOpen cannot render the modal while the Collect button is visible.
The safety timer comment says v1.3.9 while the requested release is v1.4.0; not functional, but confusing for future RCA.
seed_data_creation: Used preview test user 9970100782 / uid 76b75808-47fa-48dd-ad7c-8074678e3607. Seeded Elite active mining sessions via MongoDB for API and UI tests. API probe collected 62.1113 PRC; UI safety test collected 31.55 PRC and left the user in the normal 60s post-collect cooldown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend preview /api/mining/collect passed with auth and valid payload. Browser mobile retest logged in with 9970100782/PIN 997010, Collect button rendered enabled, double-tap produced no forced-ad overlay, then exactly one /api/mining/collect 200 response arrived after 25.86s and the collected toast appeared. Requested pytests: 36 passed. Retest after moving ForcedAdInterstitial so the active collect path renders it immediately.
rca_of_the_issue: The parent 25s safety-net works, but the Collect button's normal ad path is still broken because the ForcedAdInterstitial component is placed only in the idle-state JSX return. During an active mining session, MiningWidget returns before that JSX, so setting forcedAdOpen=true has no visible effect and no ad callbacks can fire. The safety timer masks the permanent stuck state by collecting after ~25s, but the immediate user-visible 'nothing happens' symptom remains. No MOCKED APIs were used.
